audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers carry [Skill, Sion, Sion, Skill, Skill, Sion, Sion]; the packet and the mirrored kennen__sion audit both carry [Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Sion, Kennen, Kennen, Sion].
audit.why: The page's own whys already describe the packet chart: whys[1] ends 'making levels 2-3 his window', whys[2] describes his mark pattern beating the charge, whys[3] calls 4-5 your window, whys[4] and whys[5] hand him level 6 and first item. Only the tokens were wrong. The mirror is already on the packet chart, so leaving mine would render opposite answers on the two pages.
audit.corrected: Five rows flipped as matched full/content pairs: L2 Kennen, L3 Kennen, L4-5 Sion, L6 Kennen, 1st item Kennen. L1 (Skill) and 2+ items (Sion) already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[5].why calls first item 'your spike - force fights', and no cooldown is attached to Slicing Maelstrom anywhere.
audit.why: First item belongs to Kennen here (Rocketbelt/Zhonya's), which is what the content layer already says. And his ultimate is a flat 120s at every rank — the single most punishable cooldown in the matchup, because Sion's whole all-in is gated on it and the page never gives the player the number.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now reads as his window; spikes[2].text now states the flat 120s and the 550 radius.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits the stun to Lightning Rush ('Lightning Rush-stun', 'Lightning Rushes through you to proc the stun'), claims his R can 'zap the marks off your head', calls the R a 'stun cone', and says he can 'E-cancel' your charge.
audit.why: Per Riot's text the stun is Mark of the Storm — the passive — and it fires when he lands a THIRD mark; Lightning Rush only applies one of those marks and is a 170-range self-buff giving move speed in and attack speed out. Slicing Maelstrom is a 550-radius storm that strikes nearby champions repeatedly, applying more marks; it is a circle, not a cone, and nothing in either kit removes marks. Nothing in Lightning Rush cancels a Sion charge.
audit.corrected: Stun attributed to the third Mark of the Storm; Lightning Rush described as a 170-range mobility form on 10s at rank 1; R described as a 550-radius storm that re-applies marks.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] itemization sends you into Thornmail against Kennen.
audit.why: Every damage source in his kit is magic, and Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong (the brief's onhit-itemization flag). The page's own TL;DR says 'Build MR' and then the item line contradicts it.
audit.corrected: Warmog's / Spirit Visage with Mercury's Treads, so the item line matches the TL;DR.

edits.after: Charged Q from brush is a half-HP knockup, but his Q outranges you and stacks Mark of the Storm for free.

edits.before: At two-plus items your HP stacking makes Kennen's burst pattern irrelevant in a straight side-lane brawl — his Q damage and Lightning Rush burst deal a fraction of your pool, and your zombie passive means killing you still costs him his own life if he miscalculates. Force repeated 1v1 splits and let your team react while he's stuck in side. In team fights respect his AOE R: if he ults into five marks your entire HP advantage still crumbles under a full-chain stun — peel back, let your team follow the engage, and use Unstoppable Onslaught to enter from an angle that splits his stun cone.
edits.after: At two-plus items your HP stacking makes Kennen's burst pattern irrelevant in a straight side-lane brawl — his Thundering Shuriken chips a fraction of your pool, and your zombie passive means killing you still costs him his own life if he miscalculates. Force repeated 1v1 splits and let your team react while he's stuck in side. In team fights respect Slicing Maelstrom: it is a 550-radius storm that keeps re-applying Mark of the Storm, so a group of five all get stunned — peel back, let your team follow the engage, and use Unstoppable Onslaught to arrive from outside that radius.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel  (W + passive love HP), then Warmog's Armor / Thornmail; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel (W + passive love HP), then Warmog's Armor / Spirit Visage; boots Mercury's Treads for the mark stun.

notes: The systemic error was attributing the stun to Lightning Rush. Kennen's stun is Mark of the Storm, his passive, on the third mark — Lightning Rush is a 170-range form that merely applies one mark and gives move speed in, attack speed out. That mattered for advice: the page told the player to engage 'when Lightning Rush is down', but the stun works fine without it. The level chart was wrong on both layers while the prose already described the correct one, so I flipped five matched pairs. Itemization pointed at Thornmail into an all-magic-damage kit that also applies on-hit through Electrical Surge; switched to Spirit Visage to match the page's own 'Build MR' TL;DR. Full-layer strings contain mojibake em dashes; before-strings copied byte-for-byte, replacements use plain hyphens.
